event1.title: xHeal v2 launches on iOS in the EU and USA.
event1.description: The new experience brings Today's Snapshot, routines, Timeline, chat, wellness reports, nutrition, workouts, and mindfulness together in one app.

event3.title: The core journeys become unified and repeatable.
event3.description: Onboarding became resumable, while Timeline gained search, filters, uploads, processing states, and health trackers. Privacy-filtered analytics were added to show where journeys needed improvement.

eventPersonalTrainer.title: A personal recovery shapes the Workout App.
eventPersonalTrainer.description: While recovering from his fourth knee surgery, Kalin Stoev began implementing a Personal Trainer inside xHeal's Workout App, initially building around what he needed himself. That personal starting point helped shape a workout experience designed around each person's recovery needs, current readiness, and path back to movement.

eventWellnessClinics.title: xHeal begins working with wellness clinics.
eventWellnessClinics.description: We are working with wellness clinics to bring xHeal into their programs. Their real-world expertise helps us improve xHeal, while personalized digital support helps clinics create a more connected experience for their guests.

event4.title: Today's Snapshot brings the daily experience together.
event4.description: Body, Mind, and Food appeared in one view, supported by reproducible routines based on pace, selected conditions, and enabled health areas.

event5.title: Nutrition, workouts, and mindfulness become dedicated experiences.
event5.description: xHeal gained meal logging and planning, readiness-aware workouts, guided breathing, mood check-ins, and activity history.

eventDoctorPilots.title: US doctors and xHeal users begin structured product pilots.
eventDoctorPilots.description: Interest in Doctor Ready and Health Gaps led to structured pilots with US physicians and participating xHeal users. Together, we began evaluating how xHeal could help people organize their health context before appointments and identify missing information for more prepared care conversations.

event6.title: Health data becomes connected context.
event6.description: Apple Health history and live wellness indicators were connected with documents, reports, flare-up insights, and confirmable chat actions.

event7.title: Onboarding becomes one coordinated journey.
event7.description: Profile details, goals, Health access, preferences, and account setup were brought into a single completion flow behind the scenes.

event8.title: We put the daily experience into our own hands.
event8.description: The team began a 12-week internal program while refining guided routine setup, daily tasks, completion feedback, and rewards.

event9.title: First 1,000 users. Time for v2.
event9.description: xHeal hit its first 1,000 users outside of alpha and beta testing. The feedback was in - and it was invaluable. The team had everything they needed to craft a top-notch UX and build v2 of the AI-native interface.

event10.title: AWS Partnership.
event10.description: xHeal became an AWS Partner and joined their startup credits program.

event11.title: xHeal v1 released in the USA.
event11.description: The first version goes live for American users.

event12.title: The moment it got real.
event12.description: The first predictive suggestion - not based on historical data. During beta testing, xHeal suggested Trifon check his HOMA-IR levels. The result: elevated - early-stage insulin resistance. The technology had caught something he didn't know he had. This wasn't just an idea anymore. It worked.

event13.title: Alpha testing. 95% accuracy.
event13.description: The team launched predictive models and AI-generated diagnostics against ~5,000 real patients who volunteered to check their diagnosis against xHeal's algorithms. The result: 95% accuracy. Unfortunately, their diagnoses were confirmed. The technology could see what doctors already knew. But could it see what they didn't?

event14.title: xHeal Corp. founded in Miami.
event14.description: The company was officially incorporated in Florida, USA. Headquarters: Miami baby.

event15.title: Going global. Enter Nikolay Miami.
event15.description: The team knew this technology belonged in the American market. But they needed local presence - and someone who could define the marketing strategy and sales narrative. That's when they contacted Nikolay Nedyalkov. He joined as Co-Founder and CSO - their top-notch salesman in Miami. He was in.

event16.title: Enter Nikolay. The missing piece.
event16.description: Nikolay joined as Co-Founder and Head of AI. His deep ML expertise was exactly what xHeal needed. His family - with extensive medical backgrounds - became trusted advisors. The founding team was now complete.

event17.title: The first commit.
event17.description: The first line of code was written. Kris made the initial commit to the xHeal v2 repository. The team wasn't chasing the AI hype - they were convinced they could build something real: a healthcare companion that learns from you, like a digital twin. They took the challenge head-on, aiming for a 100% AI-powered backend.

event18.title: The team comes together.
event18.description: Trifon shared his vision with Kris and Kalin. Both had gone through their own health struggles and instantly resonated with the idea. The founding team was born. A promise was made: No one should have to go through this alone.

event19.title: Four years of searching. The answer.
event19.description: After four years of reading mountains of medical literature and trying unorthodox methods, Trifon finally discovered the underlying issue: dysbiosis - his gut bacteria were completely out of balance. A disrupted gut microbiome was fueling the chronic inflammation. Once he understood the pattern, he found his way back to health.

event20.title: It started with a personal crisis.
event20.description: In 2019, at just 27 years old, Trifon faced recurring prostatitis inflammation that turned his life upside down. Nine rounds of antibiotics, one after the other, left his immune system shattered. He felt miserable - exhausted, lost, and desperate for answers. He visited countless doctors and specialists, both in Bulgaria and abroad. No one could pinpoint the root cause. So he took matters into his own hands.

Support.faqDescription: If you have any additional questions, please don't hesitate to email us at
Support.faq1Answer: xHeal Chat is your AI-powered health companion. It can answer your questions, explain your scores and reports, help you track symptoms, and guide you with personalized recommendations, making your health journey easier and more interactive.
Support.faq2Answer: Records is your secure digital space where all your personal health documents are stored. It centralizes medical records, test results, and other health-related information, making it easy for you to access and manage your data in one place.
Support.faq3Answer: Routines are daily or weekly actions like tracking your steps, logging meals, or practicing relaxation exercises that support your health goals. They help build lasting habits, boost your xHeal Score, and keep you on track toward better wellbeing.
Support.faq4Answer: The xHeal Report is a personalized health summary that pulls together your scores, vitals, and flare-up history. It transforms raw data into simple, actionable insights that you can share with healthcare professionals or use for self-improvement.
Support.faq5Answer: Vitals are your key health measurements, such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, weight, and more. Monitoring them regularly provides insights into your baseline health and makes it easier to notice changes or irregularities.
Support.faq6Answer: Flare-Up Tracking allows you to log symptoms like headaches, fatigue, digestive issues, or other recurring conditions. Over time, the app identifies patterns and possible triggers, helping you and your care team better understand and manage your flare-ups.
Support.faq7Answer: Indicator Tracking helps you stay ahead of potential health issues. By analyzing your vitals, lifestyle inputs, and medical data, it highlights early warning signs and possible risks. This allows you to take proactive measures before problems become serious.
Support.faq8Question: What is the Health Awareness Score?
Support.faq8Answer: The Health Awareness Score reflects how engaged you are with your health journey. It increases as you track routines, complete reports, and stay consistent with your health check-ins. It's designed to motivate you to take small but meaningful steps every day.
Support.faq9Answer: The xHeal Score is your overall wellness index. It combines data from your vitals, medical records, routines, and flare-up tracking to give you a single, easy-to-understand view of your current health state. The higher the score, the more balanced your wellbeing.

Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.heroSubtitle: Your Digital Twin knows your vitals, lab results, symptoms, and daily habits. Ask it anything - and get answers you can actually use.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.heroImageAlt: xHeal Chat - ask your Digital Twin about your health data and get personalised answers
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.painHeading: You have the data. You just can’t get <accent>answers from it.</accent>
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain1Detail: Your vitals live in Apple Health. Labs in a PDF. Medications in a note. Diet in a third app. When something feels off, you’re the one stitching it all together.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain2Detail: A resting heart rate of 72, HRV of 38, ferritin of 15. What do they mean together? Without context, health data is just noise you can’t act on.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.pain3Detail: You notice a pattern – fatigue after meals, worse sleep on stressful days – but your next appointment is weeks away. The question just sits there.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how1Description: Type a question in plain language. “Why am I so tired?” “What were my vitals last month?” “Should I change my routine?” No medical jargon needed.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how2Title: Your Digital Twin reads your full picture
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how2Description: xHeal instantly scans your medical records, lab results, wearable data, symptom logs, and lifestyle inputs to find the context that matters for your question.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.how3Description: No jargon. No vague suggestions. xHeal responds with plain-language explanations, specific next steps, and direct references to your data so you know exactly what it’s based on.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.useCasesHeading: Questions your Digital Twin <accent>can answer right now</accent>
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc1Question: What were my vitals last month?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc1Description: Pull any metric from any point in your health timeline. No scrolling, no searching for old files.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc2Description: xHeal cross-references symptoms, sleep, stress, nutrition, and activity to surface triggers you’d never spot alone.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc3Question: Which labs should I ask for next?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc3Description: Based on your profile and results, xHeal identifies gaps and recommends specific tests to bring to your next appointment.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc4Question: What should I focus on this week?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc4Description: Get a weekly priority based on your current trends and goals – so you always know what matters most right now.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc5Question: How has my sleep affected my energy?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc5Description: See how changes in one area ripple across others. Sleep to energy, mood to activity, stress to symptoms.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.uc6Description: Upload a PDF or photo. xHeal reads, stores, and explains each marker in the context of your full health picture.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compIntro: Most health tools stop at tracking. They show you numbers but never explain what they mean together. Your Digital Twin doesn’t just store your data. It reads it, connects it, and talks to you about it.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compRow9Feature: Generates reports for your care team
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.compClosingLine: WHOOP shows you numbers. Bevel and Olivia give you basic answers. xHeal connects 250+ parameters to tell you what your health actually means.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test1Quote: I asked my Digital Twin why I felt tired after 8 hours of sleep. It connected my HRV data to my late dinner timing. Mind blown.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test2Quote: My Digital Twin knows me better than any single doctor because it has all my data in one place. That’s not an exaggeration.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.test3Quote: The AI chat doesn’t just answer, it explains the reasoning. WHO guidelines, my personal data, everything cited. It’s like having a medical advisor.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust1Detail: Our AI partner does not store your messages and never uses them for training. Your conversation exists only while you’re in it.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust2Detail: Every answer references WHO, ADA, and EASD clinical guidelines, the same frameworks your care team uses.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust3Detail: Delete any conversation or your entire chat history from the app. No questions asked, no hidden copies.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust4Title: Minimal data in, maximum context out
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.trust4Detail: We send only de-identified signals needed to answer your question. Your name, identity, and full records never leave your device.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq1Q: Is this a replacement for my doctor?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq1A: No. xHeal Chat is a health companion, not a medical provider. It helps you understand your data, spot patterns, and prepare better questions for your care team. It does not diagnose, treat, or prescribe.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq2Q: What data does it have access to?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq2A: Everything in your xHeal profile: vitals from Apple Health, uploaded lab results, medical records, logged symptoms, medications, supplements, routines, and life events. The more you share, the more complete the picture.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq3A: Yes. Our LLM partner follows a zero-retention, zero-training policy. They do not store your personal data or use it to train models. You can delete your chat history at any time.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq4Q: What medical standards does xHeal use?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq4A: xHeal interprets health data through guidelines from the World Health Organization (WHO), American Diabetes Association (ADA), European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD), and others.
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq5Q: Can I share insights with my care team?
Feature_ChatWithYourHealth.faq5A: Yes. xHeal generates specialist-ready reports – Why Finder, My Snapshot, Clinical Report, and Health Gaps – designed specifically for sharing with your care team.

Feature_FlareUp.heroImageAlt: xHeal Flare-Up Detection - predictive pattern analysis across symptoms, sleep, stress, and activity
Feature_FlareUp.painHeading: You know something triggers it. You just can’t <accent>figure out what.</accent>
Feature_FlareUp.pain1Detail: Was it the food? The stress? The bad sleep? When a flare-up hits, you retrace your steps but never find the real cause because the pattern spans days, not hours.
Feature_FlareUp.pain2Title: The same cycle, over and over
Feature_FlareUp.pain2Detail: Good week, bad week, good week, bad week. You can feel the rhythm but you can’t break it because you don’t know which variable to change.
Feature_FlareUp.pain3Title: By the time you notice, it’s too late
Feature_FlareUp.pain3Detail: Flare-ups don’t announce themselves. By the time symptoms hit, you’re already in it. What if you could catch the warning signs 24 to 48 hours earlier?
Feature_FlareUp.how1Description: Log symptoms, meals, sleep, stress, medications, and activity. xHeal also pulls data from Apple Health and your wearables automatically.
Feature_FlareUp.how2Description: Our AI cross-references 250+ parameters over time to identify triggers and early warning signals unique to your body.
Feature_FlareUp.how3Description: When xHeal detects a familiar pattern forming, it alerts you with enough time to intervene, change course, and potentially prevent the flare-up entirely.
Feature_FlareUp.useCasesHeading: Patterns your Digital Twin <accent>can uncover for you</accent>

Feature_FlareUp.uc2Question: Is gluten actually a trigger for me?
Feature_FlareUp.uc2Description: Stop guessing. xHeal correlates your food logs with symptom timing to confirm or rule out suspected triggers.
Feature_FlareUp.uc3Question: Does poor sleep make my symptoms worse?
Feature_FlareUp.uc3Description: See exactly how sleep quality, duration, and timing affect your symptom severity the next day.
